method: Each PDF was text-extracted with pdftotext, rendered page-by-page with Poppler, and every rendered page was visually inspected against the extracted text. OCR was not required because the digital text and reviewed renders agreed.

artifacts.title: Loan Estimate — Fixed Rate Loan Sample
artifacts.reviewObservation: PDF page 1 is the CFPB cover. PDF pages 2-4 are a legible completed three-page Loan Estimate for a fixed-rate purchase. Loan terms, projected payments, closing-cost detail, cash-to-close calculation, comparison data and contacts match the digital text.

artifacts.title: Closing Disclosure — Fixed Rate Loan Sample
artifacts.reviewObservation: PDF page 1 is the CFPB cover. PDF pages 2-6 are a legible completed five-page Closing Disclosure for a fixed-rate purchase. Final terms, paid-by columns, cash-to-close and transaction summaries, escrow/loan disclosures, contacts and receipt signature area match the digital text.

artifacts.title: Final Truth in Lending Disclosure and HUD-1 Settlement Statement
artifacts.reviewObservation: PDF pages 1-2 show the former final Truth in Lending disclosure. PDF pages 3-5 show a legible completed HUD-1 with borrower/seller summaries, settlement-charge line groups, comparison table and loan terms. All reviewed pages match the extracted digital text.

artifacts.title: ALTA Settlement Statement — Combined
artifacts.reviewObservation: All three pages of the blank ALTA combined model are legible. Seller and buyer debit/credit columns, financial/loan charges, impound/escrow, recording/transfer and pay-off sections match the digital text. The form states ALTA adoption on May 1, 2015.
